comment: Verifies the remote-image pipeline inside a real host: the fixture thread's must render as the blocked-by-default 'Show images' banner (strict-CSP hosts like claude.ai block remote img-src; we normalize all hosts to click-to-show). The interact step clicks the banner, driving a real app->host->/mcp gmail_inbox.fetch_image round-trip; .invalid never resolves, so the SSRF guard rejects it identically offline and in open-egress CI and the banner deterministically re-renders as 'Retry'. Only the real server's error response produces that state.
prompt: Open the Series A term sheet email thread.
